title_it: Mehmet, Hotel Excelsior Vienna (turco): Marea 2 Evo, divaga, perdita dal gruppo, matricola sbagliata, codice di un'altra macchina
title_en: Mehmet, Hotel Excelsior Vienna (Turkish): Marea 2 Evo, rambles, group leak, wrong serial, code of another machine

lines.cue: Good morning, Sereni service, Michael speaking. How can I help you?
lines.text: Good morning. I am Mehmet, I am the head barista of Hotel Excelsior in Vienna. We have your machine, the Marea 2 Evo, the three group, since February. It is a very nice machine, we make maybe six hundred coffees at breakfast.
lines.expect_it: Macchina: Marea 2 Evo. NESSUN sintomo (frase generica, esca).

lines.cue: Thank you Mehmet. What can I do for you?
lines.text: So, the problem is on the left group. When I lock the portafilter, water comes out around the edge, around the handle. It drips on the cup.
lines.expect_it: Apre «Perdita dal gruppo», passo 1 (da dove esce).

lines.cue: Does the water come from the rim of the portafilter, or from the group body above it?
lines.text: From the rim, from the edge of the portafilter. Not from above.
lines.expect_it: Tu scegli «Dal bordo del portafiltro» → passo età guarnizione.

lines.cue: How old is the gasket, and does the portafilter lock past the centre?
lines.text: Original gasket, but the handle goes very far, more than the middle, almost to the right side.
lines.expect_it: Tu scegli «Oltre il centro» → esito: GE-2140 + GE-2210, lo monta il cliente, frase pronta.

lines.cue: You need a new group gasket and shower screen. Do you have the serial number?
lines.text: One moment. The plate says zero five two, seven one eight.
lines.expect_it: Matricola con una cifra sbagliata: propone 052710 (Hotel Excelsior, in garanzia fino a marzo 2028) e chiede conferma.

lines.cue: I read 0 5 2 7 1 0 on file: Hotel Excelsior, installed March 2026, under warranty. Correct?
lines.text: Yes, sorry, zero five two, seven one zero. Yes, Hotel Excelsior.
lines.expect_it: Scheda macchina confermata, garanzia OK: ricambio gratuito.

lines.cue: The gasket is free under warranty. I ship it from Rotterdam, one or two days, you can fit it yourself with the sheet.
lines.text: Perfect. Ah, on the old gasket packaging it says G E twenty-four ten. Is it the same one?
lines.expect_it: GE-2410 esiste ma NON è compatibile (Onda): scheda «non adatta» + proposta GE-2140.

lines.cue: GE-2410 is the Onda gasket, it does not fit your machine. The correct one is GE-2140, I send that. Anything else?
lines.text: No, that is all. Thank you very much, goodbye.
lines.expect_it: «Chiudi chiamata» → resoconto: ricambio montato dal cliente, in garanzia.
